disclaimer: Technical cloud posture checks provide partial, automated control evidence only. Passing technical checks NEVER establishes full organizational compliance with CIS, NIST CSF 2.0, or ISO/IEC 27001:2022.

frameworks.name: CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark
frameworks.description: Prescriptive security configuration baseline for Amazon Web Services.

controls.title: Ensure MFA is enabled for all IAM users with a console password
controls.rationale: Reduces credential stuffing and account takeover risk for console users.
controls.limitations: Does not validate IdP/SAML MFA enforcement outside native IAM users.

controls.title: Ensure IAM policies with full '*:*' administrative privileges are not attached
controls.rationale: Enforces least privilege and limits blast radius of compromised identities.
controls.limitations: Evaluates policy JSON directly; does not compute SCP or permission boundary overrides.

controls.title: Ensure S3 buckets are configured with Block Public Access
controls.rationale: Prevents unintended public exposure of object storage.
controls.limitations: Does not verify application-layer pre-signed URL exposure.

controls.title: Ensure EBS volume encryption is enabled
controls.rationale: Protects block storage data at rest.
controls.limitations: Does not evaluate KMS key rotation policies or key grants.

controls.title: Ensure CloudTrail is enabled in all regions
controls.rationale: Maintains multi-region API audit logging for detection and forensics.
controls.limitations: Does not verify S3 bucket log retention immutability or SIEM ingestion latency.

controls.title: Ensure no security groups allow ingress from 0.0.0.0/0 to remote admin ports
controls.rationale: Reduces direct internet brute-force and exploit exposure on SSH/RDP.
controls.limitations: Does not evaluate NACL or transit gateway routing reachability.

frameworks.name: CIS Microsoft Azure Foundations Benchmark
frameworks.description: Prescriptive security configuration baseline for Microsoft Azure subscriptions.

controls.title: Ensure subscription Owner/privileged RBAC roles are minimized
controls.rationale: Limits standing privileged access at subscription scope.
controls.limitations: Does not inspect Entra ID PIM eligible roles without Graph PrivilegedAccess permissions.

controls.title: Ensure Microsoft Defender for Cloud is enabled
controls.rationale: Provides native cloud workload and posture alerting.
controls.limitations: Checks subscription pricing tier only; does not verify alert response playbooks.

controls.title: Ensure public anonymous blob access is disabled on Storage Accounts
controls.rationale: Prevents unauthenticated blob downloads and enforces encrypted transport.
controls.limitations: Does not inspect Shared Access Signature (SAS) token expiration hygiene.

controls.title: Ensure Activity Log Diagnostic Settings exist
controls.rationale: Preserves Azure control-plane audit logs beyond default 90-day retention.
controls.limitations: Does not validate downstream Log Analytics retention duration.

controls.title: Ensure NSG inbound rules restrict SSH/RDP from Internet
controls.rationale: Prevents direct internet exposure of VM management ports.
controls.limitations: Does not trace Azure Firewall or effective NIC route tables.

controls.title: Ensure Key Vault uses RBAC, purge protection, and private access
controls.rationale: Protects cryptographic keys and secrets from deletion and unauthorized access.
controls.limitations: Does not audit individual secret expiration dates or rotation schedules.

frameworks.name: NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF)
frameworks.description: Outcome-based cybersecurity risk governance, protection, and detection framework.

controls.title: Access permissions, entitlements, and authorizations are managed using least privilege
controls.rationale: Flags standing administrative wildcards and excessive RBAC bindings.
controls.limitations: Organizational access review cadence and HR offboarding processes are out of scope.

controls.title: The confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data-at-rest are protected
controls.rationale: Verifies storage public-access blocks and encryption-at-rest configurations.
controls.limitations: Data classification governance and backup restoration testing are not verified automatically.

controls.title: Networks and network services are monitored to find potentially adverse events
controls.rationale: Checks whether cloud audit logging and native security monitoring are active.
controls.limitations: SOC staffing, triage SLAs, and incident response drills cannot be verified by API checks.

frameworks.name: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A
frameworks.description: Information Security Management System (ISMS) Annex A reference controls.

controls.title: Privileged access rights
controls.rationale: Detects overly broad cloud administrative privileges.
controls.limitations: Technical evidence only; formal ISMS policy, management review, and audit artifacts are required.

controls.title: Logging
controls.rationale: Verifies control-plane audit log capture across AWS and Azure.
controls.limitations: Does not cover application-level logs, clock synchronization, or legal retention requirements.

controls.title: Networks security
controls.rationale: Identifies unrestricted internet ingress on sensitive administrative ports.
controls.limitations: Covers cloud firewall ingress rules only; does not cover IDS/IPS or physical network controls.

controls.title: Use of cryptography
controls.rationale: Checks storage/volume encryption-at-rest and TLS 1.2+ transport enforcement.
controls.limitations: Cryptographic policy governance and certificate lifecycle management require manual audit.
